_comment: Pre-supported x86 laptop/desktop hardware profiles for the Generator Studio. Each profile fills concrete build settings (gpu_driver, enable_wifi/bluetooth) so picking a machine yields a tuned image. The hardware scanner is NOT one of these entries -- it lives on the Hardware step (the 'Scan THIS machine' button in gui/pages/hardware.py, the page that owns the three fields it writes); a synthetic 'this-machine-scan' profile here offered the same scan one page earlier, on RolePage, and was removed as a duplicate (operator report 2026-08-26, decision 2a). Curated from Framework + best-sellers on Amazon/Best Buy/Costco/Walmart; extend freely.

profiles.label: ASUS VivoBook F512DA (Ryzen 7 3700U / Vega 10)
profiles.notes: Amazon ASUS laptop; integrated Radeon Vega 10; bundle a /home copy (no data SSD).

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 13 (AMD Ryzen 7040)
profiles.notes: Framework 13 AMD; Radeon 780M; MediaTek MT7922 Wi-Fi/BT; excellent mainline support.

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 13 (Intel Core Ultra / 13th gen)
profiles.notes: Framework 13 Intel; Iris Xe / Arc; Intel AX210 Wi-Fi/BT.

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 16 (AMD Ryzen 7040HS, optional RX 7700S)
profiles.notes: Framework 16 AMD; optional discrete Radeon RX 7700S expansion bay; MT7922.

profiles.label: Framework Laptop 12 (Intel)
profiles.notes: Framework 12; Intel iGPU; convertible.

profiles.label: Dell XPS 13 (Intel)
profiles.notes: Best Buy/Costco best-seller; Intel iGPU + AX211.

profiles.label: Dell Latitude (business, Intel)
profiles.notes: Enterprise line, same Intel iGPU/Killer-or-Intel Wi-Fi generation as the XPS; widely deployed, well-supported mainline.

profiles.label: Lenovo ThinkPad E14 (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: Popular business laptop; pick intel/amd-free by the scan.

profiles.label: Lenovo ThinkPad T14 / T14s (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: The classic "ThinkPads run Linux great" line — Intel or AMD iGPU depending on SKU, Intel AX/MediaTek Wi-Fi; excellent mainline support.

profiles.label: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon (Intel)
profiles.notes: Flagship ultralight ThinkPad; Intel Iris Xe + Intel AX Wi-Fi; long track record of clean mainline support.

profiles.label: HP Pavilion 15 (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: Walmart/Best Buy best-seller.

profiles.label: HP EliteBook (business, Intel)
profiles.notes: HP's enterprise line; Intel iGPU, Intel/Realtek Wi-Fi depending on year.

profiles.label: Acer Aspire 5 (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: Amazon best-seller budget laptop.

profiles.label: Acer Swift (Intel, ultralight)
profiles.notes: Acer's thin-and-light line; Intel iGPU.

profiles.label: ASUS ZenBook (Intel, ultralight)
profiles.notes: ASUS's premium ultralight line, sibling to the VivoBook already above; Intel Iris Xe on recent generations.

profiles.label: Apple MacBook (Intel, pre-Apple-Silicon)
profiles.notes: Intel Macs only; Broadcom Wi-Fi needs firmware; Apple Silicon NOT x86.

profiles.label: Microsoft Surface Laptop (Intel)
profiles.notes: CAVEAT, unlike the rest of this list: Surface hardware historically needs the community linux-surface kernel patches for touch/keyboard/camera/Wi-Fi — a plain mainline build (what this generator ships) will boot and get a display, but several input/power peripherals may not work until those patches are integrated. Flag prominently in the GUI rather than implying full parity with the other profiles.

profiles.label: Samsung Galaxy Book (Intel)
profiles.notes: Intel iGPU; Wi-Fi chipset varies by region/SKU (Intel AX common in US models).

profiles.label: MSI Modern 14 (Intel, mainstream)
profiles.notes: MSI's non-gaming thin-and-light line; Intel iGPU.

profiles.label: VAIO SX14 (Intel)
profiles.notes: Sony exited the PC business in 2014; VAIO Corporation (Japan Industrial Partners) is the current maker of anything VAIO-branded post-2014 — there is no current "Sony laptop" to profile separately.

profiles.label: Dynabook Tecra (formerly Toshiba, Intel)
profiles.notes: Toshiba sold its PC business to Sharp in 2018-2020; laptops rebranded Dynabook. Machines bought in the early part of a 7-year window may still say Toshiba on the case but are the same hardware lineage.

profiles.label: Panasonic Toughbook (rugged, Intel)
profiles.notes: Rugged/semi-rugged line; standard Intel iGPU under the armor, but Wi-Fi/GPS modules vary a lot by configuration — verify against the specific model's spec sheet.

profiles.label: Jumper EZbook (Intel, budget)
profiles.notes: Budget Chinese brand sold mostly via Amazon/AliExpress; low-power Intel Celeron/Pentium iGPU, often a cheaper Realtek Wi-Fi/BT combo chip — broadly mainline-supported but less battle-tested than the majors above.

profiles.label: Fujitsu LIFEBOOK (business, Intel)
profiles.notes: Fujitsu's enterprise laptop line; Intel iGPU.

profiles.label: LG gram (Intel, ultralight)
profiles.notes: Known for very long battery life in a light chassis; Intel iGPU + Intel Wi-Fi.

profiles.label: Lenovo Legion 5 (Ryzen + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: Best Buy gaming best-seller; hybrid AMD iGPU + NVIDIA dGPU (PRIME).

profiles.label: ASUS ROG Strix G16 (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: Costco/Best Buy gaming; Intel + NVIDIA RTX.

profiles.label: Dell G15 (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: Walmart/Best Buy gaming best-seller.

profiles.label: Alienware m16 (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: Dell's premium gaming sub-brand; same hybrid Intel+NVIDIA PRIME setup as the Dell G15.

profiles.label: Razer Blade 15 (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: Premium thin gaming laptop; Intel + NVIDIA PRIME; Razer's own Synapse/Chroma lighting tools are Windows-only and simply won't be present, which is expected.

profiles.label: MSI Stealth (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: MSI's thin gaming line; Intel + NVIDIA PRIME.

profiles.label: GIGABYTE AORUS (Intel + NVIDIA RTX)
profiles.notes: GIGABYTE's gaming laptop line; Intel + NVIDIA PRIME.

profiles.label: Gaming Desktop — NVIDIA RTX (generic)
profiles.notes: iBUYPOWER/CyberPowerPC/Skytech best-sellers (Amazon/Best Buy/Walmart/Costco); RTX 40-series; wired Ethernet.

profiles.label: Gaming Desktop — AMD Radeon (generic)
profiles.notes: Radeon RX 7000-series prebuilts; free amdgpu/mesa.

profiles.label: Corsair Vengeance prebuilt (NVIDIA/AMD)
profiles.notes: Corsair's prebuilt gaming desktop line (Corsair itself is primarily a peripherals/PSU/case maker); GPU vendor varies by SKU — pick nvidia/amd-free by the scan.

profiles.label: Minisforum mini PC (Intel/AMD)
profiles.notes: Popular budget mini-PC brand (UM/NAB/NPB series); standard Intel or AMD iGPU, Wi-Fi module varies by SKU.
